mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.annotation_id,m.document_id,k.document_revision,h.current_document_revision, m.body_sha256,h.revision AS document_head_revision,a.revision,a.status,a.classification FROM annotation a JOIN annotation_effective_anchor e ON e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND e.project_id=a.project_id AND e.annotation_id=a.annotation_id JOIN annotation_anchor k ON k.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND k.project_id=e.project_id AND k.annotation_id=e.annotation_id AND k.anchor_id=e.anchor_id JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.project_id=a.project_id AND m.document_revision=k.document_revision JOIN document_head h ON h.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND h.project_id=m.project_id AND h.document_id=m.document_id WHERE a.annotation_id=#{annotationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(MAX(v.boundary),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'NONE') FROM ( SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) v

SELECT a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.annotation_id,k.document_revision,k.node_id,k.selection,k.selection_artifact_id, k.selection_sha256 AS quoted_sha256,a.status,a.content,a.actor_id,a.schema_version,a.schema_manifest_sha256,a.created_by,a.created_at, a.classification,a.revision,a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation_reply r WHERE r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.project_id=a.project_id AND r.annotation_id=a.annotation_id) AS reply_count FROM annotation a JOIN annotation_anchor k ON k.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND k.project_id=a.project_id AND k.annotation_id=a.annotation_id WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.annotation_id=#{annotationId} AND k.document_revision=#{historicalDocumentRevision} AND k.annotation_revision=(SELECT MAX(historical_anchor.annotation_revision) FROM annotation_anchor historical_anchor WHERE historical_anchor.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND historical_anchor.project_id=a.project_id AND historical_anchor.annotation_id=a.annotation_id AND historical_anchor.annotation_revision <= #{historicalRevision}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation_reply WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation_decision r WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId}
SELECT FROM annotation_decision r WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} ORDER BY revision LIMIT #{fetchLimit}
SELECT FROM annotation_decision r WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} AND decision_id=#{decisionId}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='RV-06-DECISION-1' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{annotationId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='annotation.decided'
